name: megascenes-hanukkah-card
description: Design Hanukkah cards with your greeting, your message and your signature in the design, with the menorah, a dreidel or the Star of David drawn with care.

interface.longDescription:
Write the main line, who the card is for, a short message and how you sign it, in your own words, and pick the look: blue and silver, a glowing menorah, gold and white, watercolor, modern minimal. You get a Hanukkah card with your words set in the design and the holiday's traditional symbols drawn respectfully, portrait, square or wide, ready to print, post or send.

ChatGPT tells you what the card needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The card opens in the chat and stays in your library.

Give only the words you want printed on the card: no addresses or contact details are needed.

For family, friends and colleagues during the eight nights of Hanukkah.

Limitations: designs as image files; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not mail the cards. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Set your greeting, message and signature in the design
Return the card in the chat
defaultPrompt: A blue and silver Hanukkah card with a glowing menorah, signed Love, the Cohens
A gold and white Hanukkah card for Sarah and David: Wishing you eight nights of light
A watercolor Hanukkah card with a dreidel and the words Happy Hanukkah 2026

positive.prompt: A blue and silver Hanukkah card with a glowing menorah, signed Love, the Cohens. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one Hanukkah card needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A gold and white Hanukkah card for Sarah and David that says Wishing you eight nights of light. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one card needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can design a Hanukkah card here?
positive.expected_behavior: The Hanukkah card models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A modern minimal Hanukkah card with the Star of David, square, with the words Happy Hanukkah 2026. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my Hanukkah card on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my Hanukkah card to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
